name: The Gown Journal
tagline: An independent guide to choosing a wedding dress
description: The Gown Journal is an independent editorial guide to wedding dresses: silhouettes, fabrics, lace, fittings, timelines, veils and the questions to ask before you commit. Written for brides who want to understand before they choose.
author: The Gown Journal Editors
authorBio: Guides written with input from bridal designers, pattern cutters and seamstresses, and edited to be readable by someone hearing the word tulle for the first time.
